answer.rationale: rollback_release is excluded because compliance forbids reverting the security patch. The active symptom is write-path p99 at 5x during peak settlement writes; memory_b5 is the closest analogue (offloading read/report load from the primary recovered transactional write latency same-day) and is verified before committing. Routing reads to replicas is reversible, does not touch the release, and does not risk losing customer writes, unlike regional failover mid-peak (in-flight write risk) or a circuit breaker aimed at a partner dependency not implicated here. add_capacity is a plausible fallback if the primary is CPU/IO-saturated rather than read-contended, so uncertainty about root cause is preserved; read offload is the lowest-regret first move and frees primary headroom for writes immediately.
